caption: The drawing depicts a spinning wheel composed primarily of wood with various shades of brown. The main feature is a large circular wheel with multiple radial spokes, attached to a horizontal wooden frame. The frame supports a long inclined arm, which is connected at one end to the wheel’s hub and extends upward to a spindle. A drive band is looped around both the wheel and spindle to transfer rotational motion. Additional supporting rods extend diagonally and horizontally from the frame. There is a treadle (foot pedal) at the base made of a single carved wooden piece, connected by a rod for manual operation, and a small black weight is suspended from a string near the upper left part of the device. The composition is centered on the spinning wheel, with all components clearly displayed against a plain, light-colored background.
title: Spinning Wheel
